cases.fullName: ML2 fixed coding-memory corpus meets frozen Recall@5 MRR and abstention thresholds
cases.invariant: The deterministic exact lexical temporal baseline clears the frozen corpus thresholds without embeddings graph or model reranking.

cases.fullName: ML2 bounded search never exceeds candidate result text or token caps
cases.invariant: Search considers at most 100 candidates and returns at most 20 available records within 16 KiB and 4096 conservative tokens.

cases.fullName: ML2 scope filtering happens before FTS scoring and foreign scope returns zero hits
cases.invariant: Every projection contains one exact principal repository and canonical root scope and a foreign scope observes no candidate.

cases.fullName: ML2 stale source candidates are removed before search output
cases.invariant: Missing or tampered source evidence yields zero search hits even when the FTS projection still matches.

cases.fullName: ML2 deleted or corrupt FTS projection rebuilds with identical logical hit order
cases.invariant: Derived projection loss or corruption never changes canonical dump and deterministic rebuild restores the same ordered hits.

cases.fullName: ML2 packed-style search explain survives a full process restart
cases.invariant: A new process returns the same source-available record order reasons and quantized scores through the product command.
